title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 22 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We would like to give you planning security with a longer commitment for the full 23,700 kg per year, over 24 months, as set out in the attached term sheets. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the bar would meet the specification?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment for the full volume; however, a contract of this duration requires the inclusion of an AS-14404 index clause. We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices you cited and have factored them into our revised calculation. 

Consequently, we can offer a unit price of €5.30, and our technical team will address your inquiry regarding a cheaper variant. Our current offer is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised term sheets with AS-14404 clause options
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking the cited index data into account.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We accept your request for an AS-14404 clause on a 24-month term. The attached term sheets offer a clause with or without a deadband. For more planning security, there is also a 36-month option. All sheets cover the full 23,700 kg per year, and you mentioned a focus on customers with volume. Longer payment days in two sheets ease the cash side for both of us.

Could your technical team also tell us about any cheaper bar variant that meets the specification?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised term sheets with AS-14404 clause options
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract. In recognition of this agreement, we can offer a revised price of €5.20 per unit, and our technical team is currently reviewing alternative material grades. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot is valid for 7 days. Our offer features a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised term sheets with AS-14404 clause options

Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your business. As a reliable partner for high-quality steel products, our team remains at your disposal for all your supply needs from our extensive product range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
